independentFindings.finding: Longitudinal intervals alone could accept lateral/vertical disconnection. New source gate slices actual posed triangles at adjacent common planes, evaluates crossing or containment in transverse/vertical contours, and rejects shifted middle-volume mutation.
independentFindings.actual: 150/150 seams pass over15pairs ×5poses ×2physical route lengths;42/42 total source/preservation/controls.

independentFindings.finding: Five viewed native-scale Blender frames show cardinal/diagonal taper, local short hit, real retraction and clear. Actual Unity pixels/per-frame flight/GPU ownership remain pending.

honestyBounds: Source cross-section tests are finite held-pose checks, not continuous-time or all-view proof. Rotation in source reader is normalized quaternion interpolation; actual Unity integration uses its unchanged interpolation.
The 11 imported old-art RED cases encode the new user direction and shared mapping constraints; they are not11 gameplay bugfixes.
Actual GPU allocation/readback/release, same-frame RGB calibration and >=3 distinct precontact native frame evidence require the upcoming opt-in native run.
